notes.title: Debt City Now Available on Android
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Debt City has been ported to Android. It's now available on Google Play. You'll now be able to take the sandbox city with you!

The game supports touch, gamepad, external keyboard, and devices like the Retroid Pocket.

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solohack3rstudios.debtcity]Get Debt City - Android Edition on Google Play![/url]

More to come.

-Nick

notes.title: Debt City Now Available
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45179503/386f12da7a418249ea61204d84d2bfec6604524a.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Exciting News! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387370/Debt_City/]Debt City is now available on Steam[/url].

Jump into the world of Debt City and experience an open sandbox city ready to explore. It's a slice of life sim with retro graphics, and no moral compass. Be a criminal, or be a regular citizen. The choice is yours.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3387370/Debt_City/][u]Download Debt City now and start playing![/u][/url]

Thanks to everyone for their support as always. More to come!

notes.title: Debt City: The Wait is Over!
notes.content:
Get ready to experience the ultimate urban adventure! We're thrilled to announce that Debt City will officially launch on February 25th, 2025!

Join the journey through the gritty streets of Debt City, where strategy, wit, and determination will be your keys to success. Will you rise to the top or succumb to the challenges of this unforgiving metropolis?

Mark your calendars for February 25th and be among the first to explore Debt City!

Wishlist now and get ready to take on the city.

Stay tuned for more updates.

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to welcome you to Debt City!

notes.title: New Game: Debt City - Retro Open World Life Sim RPG
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45179503/386f12da7a418249ea61204d84d2bfec6604524a.png[/img]

I am excited to announce that the campaign for my 6th indie game has almost reached it's end. This is a huge passion project of mine, and something I always wanted to make. What is it? A retro life sim set in a giant modern sandbox city. If you love slice of life games, or just a crazy game where you can stock shelves, work for Santa Claus, and complete murders.. all in the hopes of paying off a mob boss, well this might be your type of game. I hope you will check it out! You can actually preorder it now for only $10, with early access!

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/solohack3r/debt-city-retro-open-world-life-sim-rpg][b]Check out Debt City: Retro Open World Life Sim RPG on Kickstarter![/b][/url]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/45179503/a6a7e439f362cc35e8d450792d0b166292b924ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Cult of the Dragon Released
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a long time coming, but [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3053200/Cult_of_the_Dragon/]Cult of the Dragon[/url] is now released on Steam! Thank you all for your support. If any bugs pop up, I'll be sure to update the game and patch them.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45179503/c2a91bee01412ffcb53a87a6b1bbecb85318549d.png[/img]

I'm also happy to announce that I am going to be sharing some big news in the coming weeks, in regards to the next project. It's a big one. One hint I would give: it's a modern time period. Something a little different from my past games, and something I always wanted to do.

More to come! As always thank you so much for your support. I couldn't do this without all of you. I hope you enjoy Cult of the Dragon!

-Nick

notes.title: Next Game: Suramon - Retro Open World Monster Battling & Farming RPG
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to post that the next game from Solohack3r Studios has been announced. We're going to a new world with new monsters and a new blend of genres. Suramon is my upcoming Open World Monster Battling & Farming RPG. Enjoy a new life in Suramon, a land home to slime monsters. Explore an open world, grow your farm, battle slime, & save the day. The campaign is well underway. I can't wait to share more with you soon! It will be releasing in 2024, but you can support the development campaign today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43136061/25978e089739dacce6c604c0bb975fe91e11f539.png[/img]

Here's where you can [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/solohack3r/suramon-open-world-monster-battling-and-farming-rpg/] preorder the game, and support the game while gaining some awesome rewards.[/url].

Thanks for your support as always! I'm really excited for you to play this new game.

-Nick

notes.title: Beast Slayer | 8-bit Open World RPG Now on Steam
notes.content:
If you're looking for something to scratch a retro chiptune itch, my 8-bit open world RPG is now available on Steam. Beast Slayer is the third and latest game from [i]Solohack3r Studios[/i]. Embark on an adventure in a retro open world where monsters roam free. Track down and defeat dangerous beasts. With 8 different classes & your choice of gender, skills & spells, each time you play will be different. Feel the nostalgia as you listen to an 8-bit soundtrack while flying on the wings of a dragon.

I hope you check it out! It's my tribute to a bygone era in gaming, with elements of newer games like Skyrim and The Witcher. It's available now for PC and Steam Deck. An android port is coming during the holidays.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448610/Beast_Slayer/]Check it out here![/url]

notes.title: Neopunk Mobile Now Available on Google Play
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I'm happy to announce that Neopunk has been successfully ported to Android, and is now available on the Google Play store. The battle system has been altered/simplified, and a few other changes were made to make this mobile version work on Android. But otherwise it's an exact port of the PC version, just on your phone! The PC version is still the best experience for the full battle system and the higher quality music. But the mobile version is great for taking the game on the go!

[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.solohack3rstudios.neopunk]You can find it here.[/url]

More to come!

-Nick

notes.title: Neopunk is Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's an exciting day as I'm happy to announce that Neopunk is now available to the public! Thank you to all the amazing backers and supporters who made this game possible. Without you this game wouldn't have happened. I hope everyone who gets to play Neopunk enjoys it, and has a bug-free experience.

See you all in Kaanalos City!

-Nick

notes.title: Neopunk Releases on February 28th
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

While our Kickstarter backers get to play the game right now in early access, the public will get to play the game soon. Neopunk officially releases on February 28th. Be sure to wishlist and follow so you'll find out when it goes live!

Pretty soon you'll be exploring the neon-lit streets of Kaanalos City. 

-Nick
